content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents to enumerate available project documents; identify candidate_specs.md and any documents containing simulation instructions/results, radiation/dose estimates, geometry constraints, or calorimeter performance requirements."},{"id":"s2","description":"Read candidate_specs.md. Extract the three allowed absorber materials and assign material_code values 1, 2, and 3 in the order listed. Record numeric constraints: minimum thickness 2 mm, maximum thickness 10 mm, required 100 GeV energy resolution 4.5%, and residual dose limit 20 uSv/h."},{"id":"s3","description":"Read the simulation/performance documentation identified in s1. For each candidate material, evaluate or extract the 100 GeV electron energy resolution as a function of absorber plate thickness over the allowed 2–10 mm range, using the documented simulation setup. Record the numeric resolution values and the thickness/material_code for each tested point."},{"id":"s4","description":"Read the radiation/dose documentation identified in s1. For each candidate material and relevant thickness from the performance scan, extract or compute the residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown. Record the numeric dose rates with their corresponding material_code and thickness."},{"id":"s5","description":"Filter the tested configurations to those satisfying both hard requirements: energy resolution ≤4.5% at 100 GeV and residual dose rate ≤20 uSv/h. Among the passing configurations, identify the one with the lowest energy resolution; if tied, prefer the thinner plate. Record the recommended material_code, plate thickness in mm, predicted resolution, and predicted dose rate."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Absorber-F2","plate_mm":2,"justification":"Recommended Absorber-F2 with the minimum allowed 2 mm plate thickness. Absorber-F1 is excluded because its residual dose rate is 85 uSv/h, above the 20 uSv/h hard limit. Absorber-F2 and Absorber-F3 both satisfy the dose constraint, but F2 has the lower recorded residual dose rate (6 uSv/h vs 12 uSv/h). With no usable 100 GeV simulation/performance scan available, the minimum allowed plate thickness is selected as the most conservative choice for energy resolution, since thinner absorber sampling generally improves electromagnetic calorimeter sampling resolution.
